description: LAUNCHING SOON: answers 503 until hiring signals go live (GET /pricing hiring_tech.available). A company's open job postings by its domain, read from its own public job board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee) or the job postings marked up on its careers page. `status` is ok, no_openings (a board was found and is empty) or no_board_found (no public board was linked from the site; this does not mean the company is not hiring). Each opening has title, department, location, remote, employment type, seniority (inferred from the title), salary when the board states it, posted_at, the posting URL, `source` (the board API read), `ats` ({provider, board_slug}), `fetched_at`, and our own first_seen_at and last_seen_at. A field the board does not state is null. Read live when the stored read is older than `max_age_hours`. Costs $0.006 per lookup whose status is ok, never per posting; every other answer is free, and 503 when the site cannot be read. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

include_description.description: Add each posting's description as plain text (always read live).

limit.description: Openings to return, 1 to 500 (default 100). The price does not change with it.

max_age_hours.description: Serve a stored read younger than this, else read live (1 to 168, default 12).
